description_en: Queries the distribution of cross-border traffic that contains personal information
description_zh: 查询个人信息出境流量分布
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-outbound-distribution --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSensitiveOutboundDistribution

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

Compliance audit currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. The query time range must fall within one of these supported intervals. StartTime must not be earlier than the start time of the corresponding interval. The query fails if the time range exceeds the supported scope.
This parameter is optional. Default value: 1 month before the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据。查询时间范围需落在上述支持的区间内，StartTime 不得早于对应区间的起始时间，超出支持范围时查询将失败。
本参数非必填，默认值为当前时间的1个月前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify the value as a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

Compliance audit currently supports querying data only for the last 1 month, last 3 months, last 6 months, last 12 months, or from January 1 of the previous year to the present. The query time range must fall within one of these supported intervals. StartTime must not be earlier than the start time of the corresponding interval. The query fails if the time range exceeds the supported scope.
This parameter is optional. Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh:
查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。

合规审查当前仅支持查询最近1个月、最近3个月、最近6个月、最近12个月、自去年1月1日至今的数据。查询时间范围需落在上述支持的区间内，StartTime 不得早于对应区间的起始时间，超出支持范围时查询将失败。
本参数非必填，默认值为当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The hybrid cloud cluster ID.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland

WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id
